notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 Object Class Table preflight: when a composed object attribute supplies update type Conditional or Periodic and also supplies an Update Condition field, that field must contain nonempty, non-NA text. DIF permits partial attribute rows, so Umbra preserves an omitted Update Condition field rather than manufacturing one. This does not parse or prove the Periodic rate grammar, validate initial-condition prose, or apply the candidate's conflicting Static/NA direction; RL-046 records the supplied official 2025 Static/On change example tension. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
